title: Services Sales Executive
description:
**SERVICES SALES EXECUTIVE — INDIA** 





 Software Development \& Managed Engineering · 12th Wonder · Pune
 




  






 12th Wonder has delivered custom software and managed engineering teams to 100\+ Indian enterprises since 2012\. The delivery engine is proven — 70 engineers, a Pune centre operational since 2019, and a client base that renews.
 




  






 What's missing is a dedicated hunter who can systematically connect this capability to new buyers. We're hiring a Services Sales Executive to own a territory, build pipeline from scratch, and close new\-logo deals across India.
 




  










**THE ROLE** 




  





 This is a pure selling role. No team to manage in year one. No SDR motion to build. Your job is to find enterprise buyers who need custom software development or managed engineering capacity, and close them.
 



  





**You'll spend 80%\+ of your time in front of customers** 
 — identifying strategic accounts, building relationships with CXOs and engineering leaders, running discovery, shaping solutions with our pre\-sales and delivery teams, writing proposals, negotiating contracts, and closing. The remaining time goes into pipeline hygiene, forecasting, and sharpening your territory plan.
 



  





**You own your territory and your number.** 
 You'll define target accounts within assigned segments, decide your outbound approach, and run your own pipeline cadence. You'll have a pre\-sales engineer and delivery leadership behind you on every qualified opportunity — but the deal is yours to win or lose.
 



  





**Your buyer:** 
 India\-domiciled enterprises across three primary segments — automotive OEMs and Tier\-1 suppliers, testing and certification (TIC) labs, and enterprise engineering R\&D centres. Rupee\-denominated, relationship\-led, CXO\-level deals averaging \~₹20 lakh. Pune's position inside the Chakan–Talegaon supplier belt puts the densest cluster of target accounts within a morning's drive.
 



  





**WHAT YOU'RE SELLING** 




  





 Two proven service lines, both with referenceable customers and repeatable delivery models:
 



  





**Custom software development.** 
 Full\-stack engineering teams that design, build, and ship applications for enterprise clients — web, mobile, cloud, data, and integration. Engagements typically start as fixed\-scope projects and expand into ongoing development partnerships.
 



  





**Managed engineering teams.** 
 Dedicated engineering capacity operated from our Pune centre, embedded in the client's product or platform roadmap. Longer\-duration, higher\-ACV engagements with sticky renewal economics. Clients retain technical control; we provide the team, the management layer, and the delivery infrastructure.
 



  





 Both service lines sell to the same buyers through the same motion. The typical land is a ₹15–25 lakh project engagement; the expand is a managed team at 3–5x the initial contract value.
 



  





**WHAT YOU'LL HAVE BEHIND YOU** 




  





 You're not selling a pitch deck. You're selling a delivery capability that already works.
 



  






 — 
 
 70\-person engineering team across full\-stack development, managed teams, and R\&D services
 




 — 
 
 100\+ existing customers — referenceable proof that the delivery model works
 




 — 
 
 Pre\-sales engineering support on every qualified opportunity
 




 — 
 
 Pune delivery centre operational since 2019, inside the automotive supplier belt
 




 — 
 
 CRM, data tools, and an events budget from day one
 




 — 
 
 Direct reporting line to the COO, with weekly leadership access
 



  





**RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





**Hunt new logos.** 
 Identify and qualify enterprise accounts within your territory. Build your own outbound pipeline through cold outreach, referrals, events, LinkedIn, and partnerships. No inbound engine exists — you create the conversations.
 



  





**Run the full sales cycle.** 
 From first meeting through discovery, solution shaping, proposal, negotiation, and close. You'll work with pre\-sales engineers to scope engagements and with delivery leadership to confirm capacity and timelines.
 



  





**Grow accounts after landing.** 
 The land\-and\-expand model is central. A ₹20 lakh project win should become a ₹60–80 lakh managed team engagement within 12 months. You own the relationship end\-to\-end.
 



  





**Maintain pipeline discipline.** 
 Keep CRM current. Forecast accurately. Maintain pipeline coverage at 3x the forward quarter. Report weekly on stage progression, win/loss, and coverage gaps.
 



  





**MILESTONES** 




  





***Exhibit 1: Year\-one delivery cadence***




**Timeframe** 




**Expected Outcome** 




**First 30 days** 




 Territory plan defined. Target account list of 50\+ accounts built and prioritised. CRM configured. First outbound sequences live.
 



**First 60 days** 




 Minimum 15 first meetings completed. At least 5 qualified opportunities in pipeline with identified budget and decision\-maker.
 



**First 90 days** 




 Pipeline value at 2x forward target. First proposals submitted. At least one deal in advanced negotiation.
 



**First 180 days** 




 First closed\-won deals on the board. Pipeline coverage at 3x forward target. Clear expansion path identified in at least two landed accounts.
 



**End of year one** 




 ₹75 lakh in closed revenue — roughly four deals at our average size. At least one account in active expansion from project to managed team.
 



  





**REQUIREMENTS** 




  






 — 
 
 3–6 years in B2B sales of software development, IT services, or engineering services to Indian enterprises
 




 — 
 
 Has built pipeline through outbound — not just worked marketing\-generated leads
 




 — 
 
 Comfortable selling to CXOs, CTOs, engineering heads, and procurement
 




 — 
 
 Can articulate a delivery model and defend a rate card in a pricing conversation
 




 — 
 
 Thinks in pipeline coverage, conversion rates, and forecast accuracy
 




 — 
 
 Wants a role where commission is uncapped and effort directly drives income
 



  





**Nice to have:** 
*An existing network in the Pune–Chakan–Talegaon automotive belt or the TIC/testing sector; experience closing services deals in the ₹15–30 lakh range; exposure to staff augmentation or managed\-team delivery models.* 




  





**COMPENSATION** 




  





 Cash role — fixed plus variable, no ESOP attached. We'd rather be transparent about the economics than quote an OTE and let you reverse\-engineer it.
 



  





***Exhibit 2: Compensation structure***




**FIXED** 




**TARGET** 




**VARIABLE AT PLAN** 




**OTE AT PLAN** 




**₹12–15L** 




**₹75 lakh** 




**₹5\.6L** 




**₹18–21L** 




  





**Variable is a flat 7\.5% of closed revenue, uncapped.** 
 The rate doesn't taper past target — close ₹1 crore and the plan pays ₹7\.5L variable, no renegotiation. Variable pays pro\-rata from 70% of target, on revenue closed at or above floor margin. We're not going to pay you to discount, and you shouldn't want a plan that does.
 



  





**DETAILS** 




  





***Exhibit 3: Role parameters***




**Location\-** 
 Pune.
 



**Buyer geography\-** 
 India\-domiciled enterprises
 



**Reports to\-** 
 Chief Operating Officer
 



**Year\-one target\-** 
 ₹75 lakh in closed revenue
 



**Typical deal size \-** 
 \~₹20 lakh
 



**Travel\-** 
 \~30%, primarily metro India and the Pune industrial belt
 



**Team \-** 
 Individual contributor. Pre\-sales and delivery support on qualified deals.
 



**Start\-** 
 Immediate
 



  










**HOW HIRING WORKS** 




  





 Three conversations over about two weeks:
 



  





**1\. Screening call (30 min)** 
 — your track record, deal examples, and whether the buyer profile matches what you've sold.
 



**2\. Pipeline walkthrough (60 min)** 
 — pick one of your best deals and walk us through it end\-to\-end: how you found it, how you qualified it, how you closed it, and what you'd do differently.
 



**3\. Leadership conversation (45 min)** 
 — with the COO: territory, the number, and the terms.
 



  





 Decision within 5 working days of the last conversation, either way.
 



  





**INTERESTED?** 




  





 Send your CV and a short note to
 **HR@12thwonder.com** 
 — tell us about the best services deal you ever sourced and closed yourself. Three lines beats a cover letter.
 



  





*If your instinct reading this is "give me the territory and get out of my way" — we should talk.* 




  





*12th Wonder is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on evidence of capability and nothing else.*

title: Inside Sales Executive
description:
About us
 
 CloudYali helps organizations reduce cloud waste and achieve measurable cost savings across AWS, GCP, Azure, and modern AI environments. Most of our customers are in the US.
 



 We're a small team in Pune. I'm Nishant, the founder — you'd be working with me directly, and you'd be our first dedicated sales hire.
 



  




 What you'll do
 * Prospect into US accounts and call them. You'll research accounts in Apollo, write sequences in PlusVibe, and make cold calls every day.
* Qualify inbound leads and leads from our marketing, and book discovery calls and demos.
* Run the first call with cloud, DevOps, platform and finance leaders, and book the next one.
* Keep HubSpot up to date — correct pipeline stages, and notes the rest of us can read.
* Tell us what you're hearing on calls. We change our messaging and our product based on it.


- 

 What we're looking for
 
**Must have** 



* 3–6 years in inside sales, SDR/BDR or lead generation, preferably selling a technical product.
* You understand cloud and AI technology. You know what makes up a cloud bill, what an EC2 instance or a Kubernetes cluster is, and why companies are worried about their AI API spend. We'll teach you FinOps, but you need to arrive already understanding the technology.
* Excellent written and spoken English for a US audience — on calls, in email, and on video.
* You're comfortable making cold calls and being turned down on them.
* You can plan your own week. Nobody here will track your activity numbers.
* You can work some hours that overlap with the US.
* You've sold to US or Middle East customers.



  





**Nice to have** 



* A technical background — a CS degree, or a job in support, presales or engineering. This helps a lot in this role.
* You've used Apollo, HubSpot, or a cold email tool.
* You've worked in FinOps, DevOps, or cloud software.



  




 What the job is actually like
 
 You'll be building our sales process, not following one that already exists. That means more freedom than most sales jobs and less structure. If you want a big team and a playbook to work from, this isn't the right role.
 



  




 How to apply
 
 Email your CV to
 **careers@cloudyali.io** 
 or apply via LinkedIn.

 \- Experience mentoring or managing junior sales talent

title: Inside Sales Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 Foxscan is an independent structural diagnostics practice that supports homeowners with objective assessments of seepage, dampness, and structural issues. Using thermal imaging, on\-site evaluations, and evidence\-based reporting, the team diagnoses root causes before any repair decisions are made. Foxscan focuses solely on diagnostics and maintains no commercial relationships with contractors or material suppliers, ensuring unbiased recommendations. Certified engineers deliver structured written reports within 48 hours, helping homeowners make informed decisions about structural expenditures. The company serves homeowners across major Indian cities, including Pune, Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, and Ahmedabad.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Inside Sales Executive role based in Pune City. The Inside Sales Executive will manage inbound and outbound calls, respond to inquiries from homeowners, and explain Foxscan’s diagnostic services clearly and accurately. The role includes qualifying leads, maintaining a pipeline in the CRM, and coordinating appointments with the engineering team. The Inside Sales Executive will follow up with prospective customers, share pricing and process information, and support customers through the booking and pre\-assessment stages. The role also involves working closely with operations to ensure smooth scheduling and contributing feedback to improve sales scripts and customer experience.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong Inside Sales and Lead Generation skills, with experience handling inbound and outbound calls and converting inquiries into confirmed bookings.
* Excellent Communication and Customer Service abilities, including clear verbal and written communication and a customer\-centric approach.
* Proven Sales skills, with the ability to understand customer needs, present solutions, and meet or exceed targets.
* Comfort using CRM or sales tracking tools, with basic data entry and reporting capabilities.
* Ability to work on\-site in Pune City, manage time effectively, and handle multiple leads simultaneously.
* Prior experience in consumer services, home services, or diagnostics is an advantage.
* Minimum of a bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in sales or a related field.
* Proficiency in English and at least one regional language commonly spoken in Pune is beneficial.

title: Senior Channel Sales Manager
description:
Senior Channel Sales Manager to own the broker and channel\-partner engine for a fast\-growing flex\-workspace operator in Pune. This is a channel\-first sales role: build a productive network of IPCs (International Property Consultants), DPCs (Domestic Property Consultants), real estate brokers and leasing consultants, and convert that network into a predictable, month\-on\-month flow of qualified mandates and closed revenue.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities:
 



 \- Own ₹3\.5–5 Cr of channel\-sourced annual revenue (ARR) for the assigned city/cluster
 



 \- Deliver 2–3 channel closures per month at an average deal size of ₹15–25 Lakhs ARR
 



 \- Maintain 3x pipeline coverage on channel\-sourced opportunities at all times
 



 \- Grow the onboarded partner base to 80–100 brokers, IPCs, DPCs and leasing consultants
 



 \- Drive 30–40 active partners (submitted at least one qualified lead in the trailing quarter)
 



 \- Build depth with the top 10–12 producing partners

 \- Design and run broker engagement programs — meet\-and\-greets, centre showcases, incentive/slab schemes, co\-marketing, quarterly deal reviews
 



 \- Lead proposal generation, commercial discussions and negotiation on channel\-sourced deals
 



 \- Run a disciplined 45–60 day sales cycle from qualified lead to signed agreement
 



 \- Track competitor pricing, brokerage payout norms, new centre launches and occupancy movement
 



  





 Requirements:
 



 \- 7\+ years of B2B sales experience, with a minimum of 3–4 years in a channel, broker or partner\-led sales role
 



 \- Background in coworking or managed offices, IPC/DPC brokerage, commercial leasing at a developer, or serviced offices
 



 \- An existing, working relationship set with brokers, IPCs, DPCs and leasing consultants in Pune — this is the core qualifier for the role
 



 \- Demonstrable history of carrying and delivering a revenue number, with specifics on deal sizes, cycle length and channel contribution
 



 \- Strong commercial grounding — lease structures, flex workspace commercial models, brokerage and payout mechanics
 



 \- Comfortable operating in the field for the majority of the working week
 



  





 Good to Have:
 



 \- Experience opening a new city or micro\-market for a flex or CRE brand
 



 \- Exposure to enterprise or GCC clients on larger seat counts
 



 \- Experience mentoring or managing junior sales talent
 



  





 Interested candidates: apply via this posting, apply directly on the Bear Systems website, or send a direct message to Bear Systems with a short note on your fit and your Pune broker/channel network.
